seo.description: Improve your skills with our A2 pre-intermediate English listening test on household chores. Answer feedback and transcription are included!

parts:
A2 English Listening Test

Listen to four parents talking about how their children help with household chores. For questions 1 to 7, choose the correct answer.

See the full list of A2 listening tests

choices.html: Take out the trash.
Make his bed.

their kids shout a lot.

her teenagers only do the simplest tasks.

questions.prompt: What does Sophie say about her children?

choices.html: They didn't help at all when they were younger.
They don't walk the dog enough.
They never clear the table or take the rubbish out.
pays her kids for each chore they do.
